def fourth_largest_distinct(nums):
    """Return the fourth largest value among the DISTINCT values of nums (duplicates count once). If nums has fewer than 4 distinct values, return None.
    >>> fourth_largest_distinct([-36, 40, 46, -35, 33, 50, -2, -40, 38, -15, -2, 11])
    38
    >>> fourth_largest_distinct([2, 31, -28, 15, -16, 27, 15, -33])
    2
    >>> fourth_largest_distinct([])
    """
